issue: Lower stage can consume the last free shared GPU submission slot and suppress the upper stage
rust_fix: Keep the four-slot pool. Core supplies loaded AboveUI group count; reserve clamps at three so idle lower work cannot permanently starve. BelowUI submits only when free slots exceed the reserve. More upper groups remain best effort. No GPU wait. The reserve is capped at three slots to prevent permanent lower-stage starvation with four or more loaded upper groups.
limits: Controlled WARP reproduction establishes a concrete C++ parity regression; it does not prove that every observed live frame had this cause.
Native boundary cache and priority strategy match the pinned C++ reference. No confirmed native command inversion was found.
Missing/replaced/no-current boundary suppresses BelowUI; fixture does not claim perfect recognition of identical stale memory reuse.
Both layers may still be skipped when no slots are free; the policy remains nonblocking.
